svg.title: Max-heap tree walkthrough with total_q written out
svg.desc: For each worker A to E, the heap tree after push, the heap tree after pop with the popped node thrown to the left by a dashed arrow, and the explicit total_q addition and cost formula.
svg.text: k = 3 · 每一步: push 进 heap → 超过 k 个就 pop 最大的 → 算 cost
total_q = 当前 group (heap 里所有节点) 的 q 全部相加 · cost = rate × total_q
